name: Anbernic RG505

models.name: RG505
models.notes: Single model; colours grey, turquoise, yellow

summary: Anbernic's 4.95-inch OLED Android handheld on the Unisoc T618, positioned for PSP-era content at native 960×544 pixel-to-pixel resolution. Running Android 12 (V1.22) with documented vendor upgrade path. GammaOS Next (a LineageOS-based Android build) publishes a T618 image; no Linux custom firmware exists for this chip from the community projects tracked here. No third-party OS warning on the vendor page (unlike the RG405).

specs.cpu: Unisoc Tiger T618, 64-bit octa-core: 2× Cortex-A75 @2.0 GHz + 6× Cortex-A55 @2.0 GHz
specs.storage: 128 GB high-speed eMMC 5.1 HS400, TF up to 512 GB
specs.media: 4.95-inch OLED touch display, 960×544, PSP pixel-to-pixel, 2× rendering resolution support

variants.storage: 128 GB eMMC 5.1 HS400, TF up to 512 GB
variants.notes: Single model available in grey, turquoise, and yellow. OLED panel sized for PSP pixel-to-pixel output. Battery life claimed 8 hours, ~2.5 h charge. Hall sticks, six-axis gyro, vibration motor, 3.5 mm jack. No one-way-door warning on vendor page.

specs.storage: 128 GB eMMC 5.1 HS400, TF up to 512 GB

homebrew.name: GammaOS Next
homebrew.firmware: Android 14 (LineageOS 21) image, Full or Lite; v1.1 for the T618 devices, flashed over fastbootd.
homebrew.summary: LineageOS-based Android replacement for Anbernic T618 handhelds. Fresh install only, flashed over fastbootd after unlocking the bootloader; the device is wiped.

compatibility.note: GammaOS Next lists 'Anbernic RG405M / RG405V / RG505' with a separate v1.1 image per model and edition. Its installation wiki states there is no upgrade path from GammaOS v1.5.1 or stock, that installing wipes the device, and that the bootloader must be unlocked first (Chrome subut-rehost or unisoc-unlock), then the image flashed from fastbootd.

requirements: A Windows, macOS or Linux PC with ADB and fastboot platform tools.
Unisoc USB drivers on Windows (shipped in the release as UnisocDrivers/DPInst64.exe).
USB debugging enabled in the stock Android developer options; remove any microSD card before entering fastboot.
The GammaOS Next Patreon password while the release is still Patreon-locked (public after 60 days).
warnings: Unlocking the bootloader factory-resets the device, and installing GammaOS Next wipes it again.
Fresh install only: the wiki states there is no upgrade path from GammaOS v1.5.1 (Android 12) or stock.
